companies.name: VitaServ (Schneeberger vitaserv.ch)
companies.distributes: Online drugstore with a health food (Reformhaus) section: biscuits, snacks, chocolate and bars (Schaer, Ovomaltine, Pural, Chokay, Iswari, YFood), jams and spreads, sweets, chewing gum and glucose, alongside care and health products.
companies.channels_supplied: Sells direct to shoppers across Switzerland and Liechtenstein through its own online shop, with free Swiss Post delivery and click and collect in Basel.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Ricola sugar-free stevia sweets, Vicks sugar-free sweets, Schaer gluten-free biscuits and snacks; no direct competitor to Diablo seen.
companies.fit_rationale: Basel-based online drugstore with over 25,000 items from nearly 5,000 brands, already selling other companies' biscuits, chocolate, bars, spreads and sweets in a dedicated health food section. Its shoppers already buy stevia-sweetened and better-for-you lines, so Diablo's no-added-sugar chocolate, biscuits and spreads match the shelf it runs today.
what_they_do_well: Family drugstore business since 1961, online since 2001, delivering over 25,000 products within 24 hours across Switzerland.
